howItWorksPage.title: How mesteri.md works
howItWorksPage.subtitle: Whether you need a craftsman or you are one, our platform keeps everything simple and transparent.
howItWorksPage.clientStep1Desc: Create a free request with the job details: what, where and when.
howItWorksPage.clientStep2Desc: Receive offers from interested craftsmen. Check profiles, reviews and prices.
howItWorksPage.clientStep3Desc: Work with your chosen craftsman and leave a review when the job is done.
howItWorksPage.providerStep1Desc: Add your services, prices and portfolio. Verification takes 24 hours.
howItWorksPage.providerStep2Desc: See client requests in your categories and send personalized offers.
howItWorksPage.providerStep3Desc: Complete jobs, collect positive reviews and win more clients.
howItWorksPage.benefit1Desc: We verify the identity and qualifications of every craftsman before they appear on the platform.
howItWorksPage.benefit2Desc: Stop calling dozens of numbers. One request reaches all the right craftsmen.
howItWorksPage.benefit3Desc: Compare offers before choosing. No surprises, no hidden costs.
howItWorksPage.faq1Q: How much does it cost to use the platform?
howItWorksPage.faq1A: For clients the platform is completely free: create requests, receive offers and contact craftsmen at no cost.
howItWorksPage.faq2A: Every craftsman goes through an identity and qualification check. Verified craftsmen get a green badge on their profile.
howItWorksPage.faq3Q: How fast do I receive offers?
howItWorksPage.faq3A: The first offers usually arrive within a few hours. For urgent requests, available craftsmen reply even faster.
howItWorksPage.faq4Q: What if I'm not happy with the work?
howItWorksPage.faq4A: Contact us through the contact page and our team will help you resolve the situation. Your reviews also help other clients choose well.

about.title: Connecting people with trusted craftsmen
about.subtitle: mesteri.md makes finding a good craftsman as easy as ordering online.
about.missionText: We believe everyone deserves fast access to quality services, and every good craftsman deserves clients who appreciate them. We build the bridge between them: a transparent platform where good work is rewarded with good reviews and trust is built one job at a time.
about.value1Text: We verify craftsmen and keep reviews authentic, so you can choose with confidence.
about.value2Text: We support local craftsmen and Moldova's economy, one job at a time.
about.value3Text: From request to finished job, everything should be clear and hassle-free.
about.ctaText: Whether you need a craftsman or you are one, this is your place.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.section1Text: By using the mesteri.md platform you fully accept these terms and conditions. If you disagree with any provision, please do not use the platform.
terms.section2Text: mesteri.md is an online platform that facilitates connections between clients and service providers (craftsmen). The platform is not a party to contracts concluded between clients and craftsmen and does not guarantee the quality of the services provided.
terms.section3Text: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for all activity carried out through your account. Information provided at registration must be accurate and up to date.
terms.section4Text: Craftsmen registered on the platform commit to providing truthful information about their qualifications, services and prices, and to delivering services at the professional standards communicated to clients.
terms.section5Text: mesteri.md cannot be held liable for the quality, safety or legality of services provided by craftsmen, nor for disputes arising between clients and providers.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.section1Text: We collect the data provided at registration (name, email, phone, city), data about the requests you create and the reviews you leave, as well as technical data about platform usage.
privacy.section2Text: We use data to operate the platform, connect clients with the right craftsmen, improve our services and communicate relevant information about your requests.
privacy.section3Text: Contact details are shared only with the craftsmen you send requests to or request quotes from. We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.section4Text: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, modification or deletion.
privacy.section5Text: You have the right to access, rectify, delete and port your personal data. For any request, contact us at contact{'@'}mesteri.md.
